content.short: Mafiafoot is a blockchain-based play-to-earn football club management game.
content.description: Mafiafoot is a play-to-earn football club management game that combines tycoon mechanics with blockchain and NFT technology. It brings together two billion-dollar markets—video games and soccer—letting players earn revenue by evolving NFT cards, winning tournaments, and running their club's infrastructure. The game uses $MFF as its in-game currency, with all transactions conducted in this currency. Players build and upgrade NFT buildings and token buildings to develop their club and its facilities within a decentralized environment on the blockchain.
